snippet.title: THE LAST WORLDS : CROSSED SOULS Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
You can take part of this journey on kickstarter : https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/lupiostudios/the-last-worlds-crossed-souls-open-world-3d-action-rpg-0
You can check out the trailer, all the info, and the playable demo right on our Steam page  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297200/The_Last_Worlds__Crossed_Souls/
And if you’d like, we’d be really happy to see you on our Discord  https://discord.gg/ZEc6mH38T3 
where you can share your thoughts and chat with us and the community. Thank you!
